answer: A fundus image maps the retina's blood vessels, a pattern unique to each eye. A farm needs 175 real retinas, since the vessel map cannot be printed or photographed from outside. The fundus image is re-captured each epoch and matched to the enrolled map. The vertex check runs in the open: 175 fakes pay the full price 175 times, one honest agent pays once, and the ripple trail in the ledger makes the umber cost visible to everyone.
